</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/stations/{stationId}/check-in"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Assigns an occupant to a station — the Station aggregate's `CheckIn` invariant enforced through the application layer: one occupant at a time. This is operational state, not a labor-performance domain event in its own right (see [ADR-0014](https://claudioed.github.io/fulfillment-execution/docs/adr/0014-labor-performance-integration-hooks)): no domain event is published by this endpoint. The checked-in occupant is instead surfaced, best-effort, as `associateId` on the `TaskCompleted` Kafka event when a task claimed by this station is later completed.
